cases.question: How long must I hold a learner permit before the school will schedule my road test?

evidence.content: Meadowbrook Driving School - training terms. A student must hold a learner permit for at least ninety days before the school will schedule a road test. Road tests are booked through the front office no later than two weeks before the requested date. Lessons are paid in advance and unused lesson credits expire six months after purchase.

cases.question: If my regular driving coach calls in sick, what happens to my booked lesson?

evidence.content: When a scheduled instructor is unavailable, the school assigns a substitute instructor with equivalent experience and the lesson goes ahead at the booked time. Students are not charged extra when a substitute instructor is used. A student who declines the substitute may move the lesson once without charge.

cases.question: What does the defensive-driving refresher course cost per session?

evidence.content: Meadowbrook rate sheet, effective 1 March. Ten-lesson starter package: one thousand two hundred ninety-nine. Single refresher lesson: eighty-five. Defensive-driving refresher course: one hundred forty per two-hour session. Night driving practice: twenty-five per forty-five-minute session. Road test using a school car: one hundred five, payable at booking.

cases.question: How many lessons are in my starter package, and which transmission do the school's training vehicles use?

evidence.content: Ten-lesson starter package: one thousand two hundred ninety-nine. Each starter package includes ten one-hour lessons, one mock road test, and a written progress report. Additional lessons are eighty-five each.

Training vehicle policy. The school operates automatic-transmission vehicles fitted with dual pedals for instruction. Manual-transmission cars are available only to students who pass a manual pre-check, and lessons in them are billed at the single-lesson rate.

Road-safety handbook excerpt: a defensive driving course teaches hazard awareness, skid recovery, and following-distance control. Completing such a course may reduce insurance premiums at some providers, and it does not replace the practical road test.

cases.question: How much does the school charge to use one of its cars for the road test?

evidence.content: Meadowbrook Driving School - road test booking confirmation. Test date: 4 November at 10:30 at the regional test centre. Test fee: one hundred five, payable at booking. The confirmation does not state a separate charge for using a school car during the test.

cases.question: What is the hourly rate for night-driving practice?

evidence.content: Night driving practice: twenty-five per forty-five-minute session. The rate sheet quotes night practice per session only and does not state an hourly price. Weekend morning practice is billed at the same session price.

cases.question: What fee applies when I reschedule a driving lesson at short notice?

evidence.content: Lessons may be rescheduled free of charge when the request is made at least forty-eight hours before the lesson. The road test booking confirmation applies a rebooking fee of thirty-five for any postponement made within seventy-two hours of the scheduled test. A no-show without notice forfeits the lesson credit.

Test date: 4 November at 10:30 at the regional test centre. Rebooking within seventy-two hours of the test costs thirty-five; the test may be moved once at no charge when more than seventy-two hours notice is given.

cases.question: Does the school offer a student discount on the starter package?

evidence.content: Ten-lesson starter package: one thousand two hundred ninety-nine. No student or alumni discounts are listed on this rate sheet; prices are the same for all enrollees.
